summary: Correlate replication request stalls across client failures and server timing summaries

replay.detail: No replay or projection changes; timing observations remain host-local.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Replication timeouts, retry policy, route selection and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Replication status adds optional correlation_id and client_stage fields inside last_failed_exchange.failure. Requests carry a diagnostic x-fractal-exchange-id header. Fresh connections can report connected; pooled or unattributed connections report pooled-or-unknown. Each handled server exchange emits one INFO summary with the correlation ID, HTTP status and ingress, observed backend completion and response-headers-ready timestamps; backend timestamps are absent when no completed answer was observed. Fast successful client boundaries remain DEBUG; client failures or exchanges crossing five seconds promote their retained boundaries to INFO. Existing error display and authentication classification are preserved. Fabric direct/relay evidence remains unknown.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no backfill or coordinated fleet interruption.

manual.detail: Search both hosts' INFO journals using the correlation_id from replication status; no fleet-wide DEBUG setting is required.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior diagnostics without changing durable state.
